title: 3-Edge-Coloring Conjecture
exact_target: Does every connected three-edge-colorable cubic graph have an edge whose deletion and suppression leaves another three-edge-colorable cubic multigraph?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, supplied problems.json, record 3141 (OPG-60046), OpenGarden. Catalogue identity and source transcription; CC BY 4.0.
Open Problem Garden, 3-Edge-Coloring Conjecture. Original problem and discussion.

status_qualification: Uses simple starting cubic graphs and retains parallel edges after suppression; the equivalent deleted-graph flow condition makes the reduction precise.
